findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: .lattice/story/actives/B-137a/plan.md:39 says Claude and agy retain their canonical launcher contracts under ManagedHostRun, but docs/host-run-usage.md:253-257 and packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1630-1634 explicitly exclude and refuse agy managed execution before spawn. The retired managed-agy concept therefore remains in the newly added Story plan and makes the declared implementation behavior internally contradictory.
